Somerset Trust Company Lowered Stake in Apple (AAPL) as Share Value Declined; As Sun Life Finl (SLF) Stock Rose, Holder Intact Investment Management Lifted Its Position 
April 17, 2018 - By Marguerite Chambers 
Somerset Trust Company decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 7.65% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Somerset Trust Company sold 2,434 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 29,389 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.97 million, down from 31,823 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Somerset Trust Company who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $905.46 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.50% or $2.63 during the last trading session, reaching $178.45. About 13.99 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500. 
Intact Investment Management Inc increased its stake in Sun Life Finl Inc (SLF) by 1.8% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Intact Investment Management Inc bought 7,300 shares as the company’s stock rose 0.17% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 412,170 shares of the life insurance company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $21.38M, up from 404,870 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Intact Investment Management Inc who had been investing in Sun Life Finl Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $23.84B market cap company. The stock increased 0.02% or $0.01 during the last trading session, reaching $40.76. About 142,371 shares traded. Sun Life Financial Inc. (NYSE:SLF) has risen 12.92% since April 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 1.37% the S&P500.
